what: The four-card (QWEN_FAST_TP=4) record of packed_any_admission: the same three sections as packed_any_evidence.json at one KV head per chip (K64j flags 0x23) and the reader twin extent_attention_replay_tp.py through the 1of4 chip view. packed_any_admission.check_evidence reads it at every four-card attach and its sha256 is pinned there (EVIDENCE_TP4_K64J_OQ_SHA256), so a new record changes both in one commit. This is the record of the K64j-OQ binary: the K64j record beside it is untouched and keeps qualifying K64j.
provenance: Recorded by scripts/ci/record_packed_any_evidence_tp4.py, which takes every value from the harness reports and checks each against the admission's K64j binary, kernels and reader sha256: CB1 from run 38103473592 (experiment/c2-serving-v830), report cardm/card-20261011T015600.json (sha256 e0351a15c186a167); CB2a from run 38103543118 (experiment/c2-serving-v831), report cardm/card-20261011T015719.json (sha256 d2c6e1ab979551ff); CB2b from run 38103654555 (experiment/c2-serving-v833), report cardm/reader-20261011T015926.json (sha256 58430e1b8947ad2a). The watcher pass before CB1 is run 38103399748 (experiment/c2-serving-v829). The watcher pass before CB2a is run 38103399748 (experiment/c2-serving-v829). The watcher pass before CB2b is run 38103613175 (experiment/c2-serving-v832). The K64j binary and kernels are the pair's (K64j takes the head count and geometry as arguments). sources names extent_attention_replay_tp.py as serving/tp4-s2 holds it: CB2b ran the checkout's copy at these bytes; the admission guard is in serving_buffer_pool, never in the reader.

binary.note: the K64j-OQ binary (2b81e28f017ccf0a): the reports of this record were made on it. The decode kernels are K64j's four, byte for byte; the build of this binary proves its delta to K64j (optimisation/ttnn-op/sdpa_prefill_oneq/build_k64j_oq.sh).

CB1.what: K64j K1/K3 at one KV head per chip (6 folded rows per token): the runtime extent (0x20) at cur_pos E - 1 equals the compile-time call at capacity E, the mixed, share-slot0, trace and skip families, and the refusal of the q-slice

CB2a.what: K2 (native causal decode at 6 local heads on one KV head per chip == the extent path, bitwise; it sets the exactness policy), X7 (0x3 narrow == 0x3 wide with the real -inf tail) and Z (the 15 stale-writer families in one trace) at one KV head

CB2b.what: W10b at four cards: the real extent reader twin over pool-like lent storage through the one-chip-of-four view - R1 (the pinned mask kernel at capacity 256 == narrow_mask_host, at G8B2, G4B3 and G4B1), S (construction and restage staging: word, cur_pos and tables read back), R2 (each segment == the 0x3 compile-time call with the wide -inf mask at capacity E, over more than 50 families), R4 (idle segments at 0/32 on the zero table)
CB2b.harness: optimisation/ttnn-op/k64j/extent_reader_card_b.py through run_card_b.sh (K64J_HARNESS=extent_reader TP4_WIDTH=4), --sections R1,S,R2,R4 --seeds 0,1,2 --variants normal,peaky (the cardm action)
